content.text: Submitted and validated (ok:true). The final proposal keeps the single minimal operator flip in §12.4 — "shall not" → "may" plus deletion of the 24-month tail — which fully achieves the locked preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer). The residual duration/carve-out official checks are inherent to the fallback bargain and are not added, per the separate-bargains rule; the mutual 12-month fallback remains available in the margin comment only.
